comment: The expander holds no processing of its own: src/ansa.cpp only declares the eight jacks and eight attenuverters, and src/mortuus.cpp reads them across the expander bus. A voltage is divided by 5, clamped to ±1, multiplied by 255 and by the attenuverter, added to the eight-bit knob value and clamped, so 5V at full attenuverter spans the parameter. The channel 2 strip is read only when the edit mode is past split, at mortuus.cpp:251. A patched jack replaces its knob rather than offsetting the live knob position: mortuus.cpp:281 takes the expander path for a parameter whenever that port is connected.
